text:
Aisha Kaur: quick note from the Dedicated canary — we had a worker hotstart hang decoding a safetensors checkpoint that was delivered gzipped and missing an index. stream path blocked waiting for frames.
Danilo Ruiz: saw traces. decoder blocked on boundary read; everything upstream claimed the file was streamable.
Maya Gupta: root cause: upstream registry served gzipped payload but our stream-path assumed raw safetensors if Accept-Ranges present.
Cole Sanders: short-term mitigation idea: implement a tiny local "peek" that reads the first 256 bytes (Range: bytes=0-255) and checks magic bytes + gzip header before choosing stream vs index-first. cheap and no HEAD needed.
Aisha Kaur: agree, but we must avoid extra load at high-concurrency. add a per-host in-memory peek-cache keyed by (url, etag|last-mod) with short TTL (30s) and a cheap fallback when metadata absent (URL-only with TTL 10s).
Danilo Ruiz: also propose a manifest-level hint: model manifest can include `format_hint: sf|sf+gz|index-only` so internally trusted registries can skip probe. default remains autodetect.
Maya Gupta: telemetry: emit `peek.source=cache|range|manifest`, `peek.result=sf|sf+gz|unknown`, `load.path=stream|index`, and `peek.latency_ms`. create alert if peek.method distribution shifts towards range-heavy.
Cole Sanders: safety: if peek returns inconsistent data (truncated bytes or mismatched content-length) loader must abort streaming within 300ms and fallback to index-first. do not let decoder block on full timeout.
Aisha Kaur: runbook additions: how to set `format_hint` per-model, how to clear loader peek-cache, how to force index-first for a model, and playbook for OOM cascades during hotstart.
Danilo Ruiz: infra task: edge should support optional `x-rw-format-hint` header for registries to surface hints; but loader must not rely on it for third-party registries.
Maya Gupta: test matrix: unit tests for magic-byte detection, integration against nginx serving gzipped safetensors with and without index, load test to measure extra range QPS with cache off.
Cole Sanders: implementation plan: (1) loader peek + cache, (2) manifest format_hint support & docs, (3) probe telemetry + dashboard, (4) runbook updates.
Aisha Kaur: canary: 1% Dedicated hotstarts for 2 weeks. monitor hotstart-latency, probe.latency_ms, OOM-rate.
deploy-bot: created ISSUE-ML-2037: "loader peek + manifest format_hint + peek-cache" assigned to Aisha Kaur, Danilo Ruiz, Maya Gupta, Cole Sanders. ETA: 2 sprints.
Danilo Ruiz: I'll open the PR for the peek-cache sketch and the probe metrics. Maya you can own manifest docs?
Maya Gupta: yep, I'll draft manifest schema and docs with backwards-compatible default.
Aisha Kaur: thanks — let's keep streaming opt-in for new registries until we verify probe telemetry. :thumbsup:
